34200.meaningLit: to be felt as mental suffering

examples.text: so dummano'va samāno dummano'smī'ti pajānāti. tass'eva domanassavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ domanassavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ taṃ nirujjhati, taṃ vūpasammatī'ti pajānāti.

34201.construction:
dur > do + √man + as + *ya + ita
domanassa + ita

examples.text: ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā'ti. ruppantī'ti ruppanti kuppanti pīḷiyanti ghaṭṭayanti, byādhitā domanassitā honti.

34202.meaning1: mental suffering; faculty of distress; unhappiness
34202.commentary: (PMa) domanassayogato duṭṭhu mano assā'ti, hīnavedanattā vā kucchitaṃ mano assā'ti dummano, dummanassa bhāvo domanassaṃ, cetasika-asātalakkhaṇe ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāretī'ti indriyaṃ, domanassam'eva indriyaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, domanass'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, cetasikaṃ asātaṃ, manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ
jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ

34203.meaning1: ending of mental suffering; cessation of the faculty of distress

examples.text: so domanass'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, domanass'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, domanass'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?

34204.meaning1: appearance of mental suffering; arising of the faculty of distress
34204.commentary: (SNa) parato domanass'indriya-samudayan'ti-ādīsu'pi tesaṃ tesaṃ kāraṇavasen'eva samudayo veditabbo. pattacīvarādīnaṃ vā hi saṅkhārānaṃ saddhivihārik'ādīnaṃ vā sattānaṃ vināsena domanass'indriyaṃ uppajjatī'ti tesaṃ vināsaṃ tassa samudayo'ti pajānāti. subhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā varasayane nipannassa hatthapādasambāhana-tālavaṇṭavāt'ādi-samphassena sukh'indriyaṃ uppajjati, taṃ phassaṃ tassa samudayo'ti pajānāti. vuttappakārānaṃ pana sattasaṅkhārānaṃ manāpānaṃ paṭilābhavasena somanass'indriyaṃ uppajjati, taṃ paṭilābhaṃ tassa samudayo'ti pajānāti. majjhatt'ākārena pana upekkh'indriyaṃ uppajjati, taṃ sattasaṅkhāresu majjhatt'ākāraṃ tassa samudayo'ti pajānāti.

examples.text: so domanass'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, domanass'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, domanass'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ domanass'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?

34205.meaning1: exploration with mental dissatisfaction; examination with distress

examples.text: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, iti cha somanass'upavicārā, cha domanass'upavicārā, cha upekkh'upavicārā.

34206.meaning1: exploration with sorrow; examination with distress

examples.text: iti cha somanass'ūpavicārā, cha domanass'ūpavicārā, cha upekkh'ūpavicārā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

34207.commentary: (SaDM) ettha ca doliyati ukkhipiyati yattha nipanno dārako, yathānipannako vā'ti dolā

examples.text: tatr'āyaṃ paṅguḷ'opamā, seyyathā'pi paṅguḷo dolāya kīḷataṃ mātāputtānaṃ dolaṃ khipitvā tatth'eva dolatthambhamūle nisinno kamena āgacchantassa ca gacchantassa ca dolāphalakassa ubho koṭiyo majjhañ'ca passati, na ca ubhokoṭimajjhānaṃ dassan'atthaṃ byāvaṭo hoti.
ath'eko lolamakkaṭo rukkhā otaritvā tassa piṭṭhiṃ abhiruhitvā uccārapassāvaṃ katvā siṅge gaṇhitvā olambanto naṅguṭṭhe gahetvā dolāyanto'va kīḷi
lobho akusalamūlaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ idaṃ vuccat'āvuso akusalamūlaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso
nārado sabbaṃ taṃ pavattiṃ ācikkhitvā iminā kāraṇena ahaṃ iminā abhisapito, ath'āhaṃ, mayhaṃ doso n'atthi, yassa doso atthi, tass'eva upari abhisapo patatū'ti vatvā abhisapiṃ
imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā, na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.
pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.

34214.commentary: (VIN 1.2.8) duṭṭho doso'ti kupito anattamano anabhiraddho āhatacitto khilajāto.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
atha kho maṃ, bhikkhave, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, abhidosakālaṅ'kato, bhante, udako rāmaputto'ti. ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, abhidosakālaṅ'kato udako rāmaputto'ti.
atha kho jīvakassa komārabhaccassa bahi dvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhantassa etadahosi, mayā kho bhagavato samattiṃsāya virecanaṃ dinnaṃ. dosa-abhisanno tathāgatassa kāyo.

34217.meaningLit: discourse on the direct knowledge of hatred, etc.
34217.construction:
dosa + abhiññā + ādi + sutta + āni
dosaabhiññādisutta + āni

examples.text: so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti.

34220.meaning1: wearing away of ill-will; extinction of aversion

examples.text: tassa tiṭṭhant'eva pañc'indriyāni yesaṃ avighātattā manāp'āmanāpaṃ paccanubhoti, sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. tassa yo rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, pariññā? rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pariññā
saddañ'ca sutvā dubhayaṃ piy'āppiyaṃ, piyamhi sadde na samucchito siyā, atho'ppiye dosagataṃ vinodaye, na c'āppiyaṃ me'ti manaṃ padosaye.

34223.meaning2: wrong course of behaviour because of ill-will

34224.meaning1: with heavy hatred; with intense ill-will

examples.text: accayaṃ desayantīnaṃ, yo ce na paṭigaṇhati, kop'antaro dosagaru, sa veraṃ paṭimuñcatī'ti.

34225.meaning1: fact of being motivated by hate; state of being driven by ill-will
34225.commentary: (VINa) chandagāmitā… bhayagāmitā pāpentī'ti ete chandagāmino ca… bhayagāmino cā'ti evaṃ chandagāmitāya'pi… bhayagāmitāya'pi pāpenti, yojentī'ti attho.

examples.text: suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. ayaṃ itthan'nāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti.

34226.meaning1: motivated by hate; driven by ill-will

examples.text: chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosagāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī'ti.

34227.meaning1: fire of hatred; fire of ill-will

examples.text: kena ādittaṃ? rāg'agginā, dos'agginā, moh'agginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan'ti vadāmi.

34228.meaning1: born from hatred; produced by ill-will

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, api nu tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā uppajjeyyuṃ dosajā pariḷāhā kāyikā vā cetasikā vā yehi so dosajehi pariḷāhehi pariḍayhamāno dukkhaṃ sayeyyā'ti?
dosaṃ vineyya viharanto na dosajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā. mohaṃ vineyya viharāhi. mohaṃ vineyya viharanto na mohajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā.

34229.meaning1: small amount of aversion; paucity of ill-will

examples.text: katame cattāro? rāgatanuttaṃ, dosatanuttaṃ, mohatanuttaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, na parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

34230.meaning1: ruined by hatred; spoiled by ill-will; corrupted by aversion

examples.text: tiṇadosāni khettāni, dosadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītadosesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

34231.meaning1: state of aversion; characteristic of hatred

examples.text: sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho uccākulīnatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma me dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno yena me ekadā lobhadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, dosadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhantī'ti.

34232.meaning1: originating from hatred; with ill-will as source

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, dosapakataṃ kammaṃ dosajaṃ dosanidānaṃ dosasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati. yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajja vā apare vā pariyāye.

34233.meaning2: producing ill-will or hostility; causing anger

examples.text: tam'enaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā tīsu dhammesu samannesati, lobhanīyesu dhammesu, dosanīyesu dhammesu, mohanīyesu dhammesu.

kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā
tatrā'pi te, phagguna, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na c'eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati, na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi, hit'ānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto, na dos'antaro'ti.

34235.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of dosantara

examples.text: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacittena vakkhāmi no dos'antarenā'ti.

34236.meaning1: produced by hatred; generated by ill-will

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, dosapakataṃ kammaṃ dosajaṃ dosanidānaṃ dosasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati. yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajja vā apare vā pariyāye.

34237.meaning1: dependent on hatred; due to ill-will

examples.text: iti'ssa'me dosajā dosanidānā dosasamudayā dosapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti.

34239.meaning1: obsessed by ill-will; consumed by aversion; possessed by hatred

examples.text: yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati n'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.

ye kho, āvuso, rāgappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, dosappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, mohappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, te loke dhammavādino. ye kho, āvuso, rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa pahānāya paṭipannā, mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā, te loke suppaṭipannā.

34241.meaning1: imprisoned by aversion; held captive by ill-will
34241.meaningLit: bound with the bond of hatred

examples.text: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā rajanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya. pubbe kho, gāmaṇi, sattā avītadosā dosabandhanabaddhā. tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā dosanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya.

34242.meaning2: agitation of hatred, delusion, pride, belief, defilement and bad conduct

34243.meaning1: without the fault; free from the error (of)

examples.text: yugamattaṃ pekkhamānā, uttam'atthaṃ gavesino, āsattidosarahitā, asambhītā'va kesarī.
ettha ca paṭhamena pisuṇadosarahitaṃ samaggakaraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vuttaṃ, dutiyena samphappalāpadosarahitaṃ dhammato anapetaṃ mantāvacanaṃ, itarehi dvīhi pharus'ālikarahitāni piyasaccavacanāni.
n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhasamā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.
n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo gaho, n'atthi mohasamaṃ jālaṃ, n'atthi taṇhāsamā nadī.

34245.meaning1: with hatred as source; originating from ill-will

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, dosapakataṃ kammaṃ dosajaṃ dosanidānaṃ dosasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati. yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajja vā apare vā pariyāye.

34247.meaning1: due to anger; under the influence of ill-will

examples.text: ko hi tassa janen'attho'ti tassa aññajanassa aññena janena taṇhāvasena assitena dosavasena heṭhitena vā ko attho.

34248.meaning1: removal of aversion; dispelling of ill-will
34248.commentary: (NIDD2a) vītadosā'ti anāgāmiphalaṭṭhā. dosavinayāya vā paṭipannā'ti etena anāgāmimaggaṭṭhā. vītamohā'ti arahattaphalaṭṭhā.

examples.text: ime kho no, āvuso, ākārā, ime anvayā, yena mayaṃ evaṃ vadema, addhā te āyasmanto vītarāgā vā rāgavinayāya vā paṭipannā, vītadosā vā dosavinayāya vā paṭipannā, vītamohā vā mohavinayāya vā paṭipannā'ti.

34249.commentary: (SNa) idāni'ssa niddosabhāvañ'c'eva saṅgāma-vijaya-bhāvañ'ca dassento rāga-vinaya-pariyosānā'ti-ādim'āha. tattha rāgaṃ vinayamānā pariyosāpeti pariyosānaṃ gacchati nipphajjatī'ti rāgavinayapariyosānā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.

34250.meaning1: abundance of aversion; massive amount of ill-will

examples.text: katame cattāro? rāgavepullattaṃ, dosavepullattaṃ, mohavepullattaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

34251.meaning1: because of hatred; based on ill-will

examples.text: adinn'ādānam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tividhaṃ vadāmi, lobhahetukam'pi, dosahetukam'pi, mohahetukam'pi.

no ce chaḍḍeti, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, chaḍḍit'āchaḍḍitañ'ca jāneyya.

34253.meaning1: because of aversion; due to ill-will

examples.text: yaṃ duṭṭho dos'ādhikaraṇaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi ceteti, parabyābādhāya'pi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi ceteti. dose pahīne n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti.
dve'mā, bhikkhave, osāraṇā. atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco sosārito, ekacco dosārito.
susaṃvut'atto visikh'antare caraṃ, kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso, cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

34259.commentary: (MNa) dosinā'ti dos'āpagatā, abbhaṃ mahikā dhūmo rajo rāhū'ti imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi virahitā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: susaṃvut'atto visikh'antare caraṃ, kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso, cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?

34261.meaning1: associated with aversion; connected with hatred; to do with hatred

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

34262.commentary: (VINa) dovacassakaraṇehī'ti dubbacabhāvakaraṇīyehi, ye dhammā dubbacaṃ puggalaṃ karonti, tehi samannāgato'ti attho.

examples.text: bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.

34263.meaning1: which make one hard to talk to; causing obstinance; making one obdurate
34263.meaningLit: making hard to talk to state
34263.commentary: (VINa) dovacassakaraṇehī'ti dubbacabhāvakaraṇīyehi, ye dhammā dubbacaṃ puggalaṃ karonti, tehi samannāgato'ti attho. (MNa) dovacassakaraṇehī'ti dubbacabhāvakārakehi upari āgatehi soḷasahi dhammehi.

examples.text: bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu att'ukkaṃsako hoti paravambhī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu att'ukkaṃsako hoti paravambhī, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

34264.meaning1: unruliness; contumacy; not being amenable to verbal correction
34264.meaning2: unruliness; contumacy; stubbornness; obstinacy; lit. hard to talk to state
34264.construction:
dur > do + √vac + as + *ya + tā
dovacassa + tā
34264.commentary: (DNa) dovacassatā'ti dukkhaṃ vaco etasmiṃ vippaṭikūlagāhimhi vipaccanīkasāte anādare puggale'ti dubbaco, tassa kammaṃ dovacassaṃ, tassa bhāvo dovacassatā. (ANa) dovacassatā'ti dubbacabhāvo.

examples.text: hirīmā'yaṃ, bhikkhave, ottāpī appamatto hoti. so appamatto samāno bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
dovārikaṃ āmantesi, ajja't'agge, samma dovārika, āvarāmi dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.

34270.meaning2: longing of a pregnant woman, strong desire

examples.text: tassā me evarūpo dohaḷo uppanno, icchāmi sūriyassa uggamanakāle caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannaddhaṃ vammikaṃ subhūme ṭhitaṃ passituṃ, khaggānañ'ca dhovanaṃ pātun'ti.

idha, bhikkhave, gopālako… na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.

34279.meaning1: two inches wide; measuring two inches
34279.commentary: (VINa) dv'aṅgulā rāji na hotī'ti mukhavaṭṭito heṭṭhā dv'aṅgulappamāṇā ekā'pi rāji na hoti.

examples.text: abandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji na hoti. bandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji hoti. navo nāma patto viññattiṃ upādāya vuccati.

34280.commentary: (SNa) dv'aṅgulapaññāyā'ti parittapaññāya. yasmā vā dvīhi aṅgulehi kappāsavaṭṭiṃ gahetvā suttaṃ kantanti, tasmā itthī dv'aṅgulapaññā'ti vuccati. (THIa) itthiyo hi satt'aṭṭhavassakālato paṭṭhāya sabbakālaṃ odanaṃ pacantiyo pakkuthite udake taṇḍule pakkhipitvā ettāvatā odanaṃ pakkan'ti na jānanti, pakkuthiyamāne pana taṇḍule dabbiyā uddharitvā dvīhi aṅgulīhi pīḷetvā jānanti, tasmā dv'aṅgulipaññāyā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ isīhi pattabbaṃ, ṭhānaṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, na taṃ dv'aṅgulapaññāya, sakkā pappotum'itthiyā.

34281.meaning1: practice of (eating food when the shadow is) two finger breadths (past midday)
34281.commentary: (VINt) kappati dvaṅgulakappo'ti dv'aṅgulaṃ atikkantāya chāyāya vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ kappatī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena vassasataparinibbute bhagavati vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti, kappati siṅgiloṇakappo, kappati dv'aṅgulakappo, kappati gām'antarakappo, kappati āvāsakappo, kappati anumatikappo, kappati āciṇṇakappo, kappati amathitakappo, kappati jaḷogiṃ pātuṃ, kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ, kappati jātarūparajatan'ti.

34282.meaning1: with limited wisdom; lacking in understanding
34282.meaning2: with 'two finger' understanding (with little understanding; or whose understanding is in her two fingers)
34282.commentary: (SNa) dv'aṅgulapaññāyā'ti parittapaññāya. yasmā vā dvīhi aṅgulehi kappāsavaṭṭiṃ gahetvā suttaṃ kantanti, tasmā itthī dv'aṅgulapaññā'ti vuccati. examples.text: yaṃ taṃ isīhi pattabbaṃ, ṭhānaṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, na taṃ dv'aṅgulapaññāya, sakkā pappotum'itthiyā.

34283.meaning1: two finger-knuckles at most; (comm) two fingers and two finger-knuckles at most
34283.commentary: (PYt) dv'aṅgulapabbaparaman'ti ettha dve aṅgulāni ca dve pabbāni ca dv'aṅgulapabbaṃ, uttarapade pubbapadalopo. dv'aṅgulapabbaṃ paramaṃ pamāṇaṃ etassa udakasuddhikassā'ti dv'aṅgulapabbaparamaṃ. vitthārato dv'aṅgulaparamaṃ, gambhīrato dvipabbaparaman'ti vuttaṃ hoti. ten'āha vitthārato'tiādi.

34285.commentary: (MNa) dvaṭṭh'antarakappā'ti ekasmiṃ kappe catusaṭṭhi antarakappā nāma honti, ayaṃ pana aññe dve ajānanto evam'āha.

34289.meaning1: twice or thrice; two or three times

examples.text: cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvattikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo, attho me, āvuso, cīvarenā'ti

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.

34290.meaning1: two or three layers; two or three coverings

examples.text: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ

34292.meaning1: two or three bowlfuls; two or three full bowls
34292.commentary: (KVa) dvattipattapūrā'ti mukhavaṭṭiyā heṭṭhimalekhaṃ anatikkantā dve vā tayo vā pattapūrā.

examples.text: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.
dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti.

34293.commentary: (PYt) dve vā tayo vā pariyāyā samāhaṭā'ti dvattipariyāyaṃ, samāhāre digu, tisadde pare dvissa akāro hoti.

examples.text: atirekadvattipariyāye vematiko adhiṭṭhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa. atirekadvattipariyāye ūnakasaññī adhiṭṭhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
